attributes.name: Khai-Utef
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add 1 die to any combat check against a monster. If the monster is a villain or henchman, add another die.

Display this card to reset your hand and examine the top card of any location deck; then you may explore your location. At the end of the turn, discard this card.

corrections.corrected_text: On the loot ally Khai-Utef, replace this:Discard this card to reset your hand and examine the top card of any location deck; then you may explore your location....with this:Display this card to reset your hand and examine the top card of any location deck; then you may explore your location. At the end of the turn, discard this card.
corrections.issue: Khai-Utef lets you reset your hand and explore. If you combine that with cards that let you retrieve a specific card from your discard pile, there are relatively low-risk ways to ensure that you can use Khai Utef many times per turn. Awesome, isn't it?
